6277-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

4289-4770-6090-6633.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1021-1669-6303-6664.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

512-2872-5457.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2872-5457.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-6244--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-6244--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Saradoc triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2324-2415-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

851-4772-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

280-433-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

1417-1580-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1409-4289-6633.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

640-4184-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-4184-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Relentless Skaabs.
Relentless Skaabs dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Relentless Skaabs trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Relentless Skaabs, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1879-2388-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-1687-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-5686-7215.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6791-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-1780-5921.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve both Burdened Aerialist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2292-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
2292-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

77-5145-5231-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-4753-5326.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-4753-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Clever Impersonator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Clever Impersonator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Clever Impersonator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

333-2730-5147.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2730-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3492-3609-4868-4883.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-4868-4883.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, proliferating twice, putting two additional charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

188-2178-3523.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
188-2178-3523.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1430-2084.notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
1430-2084.description: Activate Mirror Image by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Mirror Image into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

3496-3931-5269.description:
Cast Atzocan Archer by paying {2}{G}.
Atzocan Archer enters the battlefield, fighting Dread Slaver.
Atzocan Archer dies, triggering Dread Slaver, returning Atzocan Archer to the battlefield as a black Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2.

864-4872-5163.notablePrerequisites: Roon does not have summoning sickness.
864-4872-5163.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Roon by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Eternal Witness until the beginning of your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Roon triggers, returning Eternal Witness from exile to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, putting Time Warp into your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

2026-3078-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
2026-3078-3525.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.

597-1267-3423-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Soltari Foot Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill Soltari Foot Soldier.
597-1267-3423-4600-5241.description:
Declare Soltari Foot Soldier as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Soltari Foot Soldier from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Soltari Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
Activate Aegis Automaton by paying {4}{W}, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
